principle: Authority is bounded by the minimum satisfied cap axis; emergency narrows authority unless rollback, external stop, and independent logging are present.

levels.A0: No operational authority; refuse, report, or request evidence only.
levels.A1: Information-only or reversible local advice; no deployment control.
levels.A2: Narrow reversible pilot with manual override and monitoring.
levels.A3: Monitored deployment authority with independent evidence, rollback, appeal, and external stop.
levels.A4: Broad deployment authority; requires exceptional independent verification, non-capture, sunset, and audited stop.
levels.A5: Root/security-critical unilateral authority; not grantable by claimant assertion and normally requires institutional process outside model output.
